description: Charts built on Recharts with design-system colors, tooltip and legend. Good for operations dashboards.

guidelines.config: Every key in config becomes a CSS variable --color-<key>, used as fill/stroke.
guidelines.recharts: All chart components (BarChart, LineChart, AreaChart, PieChart, …) are imported directly from recharts.

colors.title: Series Colors
colors.description: Five series colors from the brand palette: green, orange, navy, sky blue and gold.

area.title: Area
area.description: Visitors per day over one week.

pie.title: Donut
pie.description: Ticket sales per unit. Each slice uses a color from config.

parts.container: Wraps the chart: responsive and applies the colors from config.
parts.tooltipContent: Tooltip content in the design-system style (Indonesian number format).
parts.legendContent: Legend content in the design-system style.
parts.config: Label, icon and color of every data series.
